snippet.title: Poopy the Game - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Poopy the Game!! (Demo available)

https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/1047589 (Newgrounds)

https://poopy-the-game.itch.io/poopy-the-game (Itch.io)

Join the Discord to keep up with game development: https://discord.gg/ANSwmdsPnc

Play as Poopy T. Game and stop the evil entrepreneur with hideous buckteeth, John Person, from kidnapping and reselling his precious pet chicken! Explore the world dominated by Person Industry's monopoly and defeat his wack-a-doodle henchmen, including Pop-l's Munching March, Grease Under Pressure, and more! Discover shortcuts and mad speedrunning skillz with Poopy's physics-based grappling hook and the innovative enemy freeze/launch mechanic! Go Poopy! Only you can do this!!!

Poopy the Game is a fast-paced, physics-based platformer heavily inspired by the original Genesis Sonic the Hedgehog games with stupid, yet adorable characters. Poopy the Game sets itself apart from other high-speed platformers. With the completely physics-based grappling hook, and the innovative enemy freeze/launch mechanic, you can launch yourself in any direction you want, in any location you want as long as you have enough skill and speed. It results in infinite amount of skill ceiling and replay-ability, especially when you're going for a higher rank. Go for it, if you dare.

#pizzatower #newgrounds #sonicthehedgehog #indiegame
